# Create account
{: .no_toc }

Self-service signup with email and password.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `AUTH-03` |
| **Route** | `/sign-up` · deep link `substratal://sign-up` |
| **Who can use it** | Unauthenticated |
| **Kind** | auth |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Separate `AdwWindow` with `AdwClamp` |

**How you get here:** AUTH-01 link; Marketing/app deep link with optional `application_id`

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Display name | text-field | body.display_name | optional; ≤ 100 | AdwEntryRow |
| Email | email-field | body.email | required | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=email |
| Password | password-field | body.password | required; strength meter; autofill new-password; show policy hint | AdwPasswordEntryRow |
| Create account | primary-button | POST /auth/signup |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |
| Terms / Privacy | links | external |  | GtkLinkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Create account | `POST /auth/signup` | 201 AuthSession → AUTH-04 (verify pending) then APP-01. 409 email_taken → "An account with this email may already exist. Sign in or reset your password." (with details.reason invitation_pending the API re-sends the invitation: say "Check your email for your invitation.") 422 → field errors. |

## Good to know

- Pass `application_id` through when signup started from an app's link; it is recorded as signup_application_id. Every new User starts on the Free plan and receives platform-managed `free` Entitlements to every free Application, including the Hub itself (`app_hub`). No plan choice at signup; upgrading is BIL-01.
